example.com is no longer verified for single sign-on in Acme Support

The daily check has not found the TXT record _yuva-sso.example.com since 2026-10-16. After 7 days
without it, example.com is no longer a verified domain of Acme Support: its people no longer sign
in through your identity provider, and another workspace on this server may claim the domain. It was your last verified domain, so single sign-on is no longer required.

To claim it again, publish the record and verify the domain in Settings › Single sign-on.

https://yuva.example.com/settings/sso
